spec.design: Paired minimum/maximum daily withdrawal frontier on exactly the same reserve grid, product-specific frozen pipelines, budgets, first-check activation policy and eight historical windows as the prior maximum frontier. Both mechanisms are rerun to collect passive dispersion metrics. Common reserves compare policies; nearest realized average-capital matches are descriptive, not a causal isolation of dispersion. No pipeline retuning. All results are historical and in sample.

reference_spec.design: Daily maximum withdrawals, persistent demand, shared seat reservation, first-check activation or pass forfeiture. Frozen product-specific pipelines from prior shared-seat daily-maximum results. Every window starts empty with fresh owner funding. Post-startup deaths means all deaths after 365 elapsed days, including young replacements. All overlapping historical windows remain in-sample; none is a holdout. Full-tape cents around 6780.10 diagnose the known March 2026 event, not a recommended precision of reserve selection.

legacy_25k.description: Headline. Every Apex payout rule switched on, and our own behaviour is to request $500 -- the firm's minimum -- from each account every calendar month, carrying unpayable months as a backlog.

legacy_50k.description: Legacy 50K under inherited payout interpretation; user-specified $250 seat cost; see research/legacy_50k/SOURCES.md

evaluation_spec.note: Funded accounts come only from evaluations traded on the same RR signals, one position at a time: 25K at 3 MNQ (1:1 target to drawdown), 50K at 5 MNQ (1.2:1). Up to 5 evaluations at once, started only while short of accounts; each holds one of the 20 seats. Passes land on the spare shelf and the purchase policy deploys them.
